description: Supplemental Data for "Impact of Work Order-to-Asset Linkage Quality on Data-Driven Decision Support for Gravity Sewer Asset Management is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Alence Poudel (City of Sugar Land). This dataset contains supplemental Data for "Impact of Work Order-to-Asset Linkage Quality on Data-Driven Decision Support for Gravity Sewer Asset Management" with anonymized work order data for calculation and an appendix results table for verification. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. Formats: XML, Excel. Size stated: 22108. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
